text: Lola Cars, the UK race-car engineering company behind the Lola Yamaha ABT Formula E team, is owned by UK-native, US-based investor Till Bechtolsheimer.
short: Lola Cars is owned by investor Till Bechtolsheimer.

source.name: Performance Racing Industry: Lola Cars Under New Ownership
source.quote: Lola Cars is now owned by UK-native and US-based Till Bechtolsheimer.

additionalSources.name: The Race: Everything you need to know as Lola splits from Abt in Formula E
additionalSources.quote: Owner Till Bechtolsheimer has ambitions to launch further Lola projects off the back of the Formula E programme
